goals.label: Reduce handling time
goals.outcome: Fewer minutes spent on each repeat question, lookup, or request.

goals.label: Speed up approvals and onboarding

goals.description: Move requests, approvals, and new-hire or new-customer onboarding along faster.

goals.label: Improve customer experience
goals.outcome: Faster, clearer answers for the people you serve.
goals.description: Give customers, students, patients, or members faster and clearer answers.

goals.label: Strengthen compliance and risk
goals.outcome: Policy is applied the same way every time, with sources and evidence to show for it.
goals.description: Apply policy consistently, keep evidence, and catch risks earlier.

goals.label: Grow revenue
goals.outcome: More time for the work that wins and keeps business or funding.
goals.description: Help teams find, win, and keep more business or funding.

goals.label: Knowledge access and self-service
goals.outcome: People find trusted answers themselves instead of asking around.
goals.description: Let people find trusted answers themselves instead of asking around.

goals.label: Reduce cost
goals.outcome: Less manual effort and rework on routine work.
goals.description: Cut manual effort, rework, and spend on routine work.
